column1: # Every way work still reaches m2v (the Metal-to-Vulkan fallback being deleted) and what each becomes without it.
# m2v_routes_test.py keeps the product rows equal to what test/m2v_routes_scan.py reads from the plugin's sources.
# kind: product (the plugin and its compiler daemon), test (tests and harnesses that need m2v), tool (pack and seed tools).
#   A test row's route is bazel (a Bazel test, or tests named together), harness (a program or script outside Bazel)
#   or hwtest (a HW Test id); its raised_in names the dying files or targets it needs.
# route: pred (an RMPred refusal predicate), need (an RMNeed of RM_M2V), tag (a refusal line the plugin's own code raises),
#   sel (a selector raw/test/inventory.tsv leaves to m2v), bridge (a symbol of the m2v frontend or bridge), include (a
#   header of the m2v tree), class (an NB class looked up by name), ident (a field or function that holds or hands over
#   m2v objects), twin (an identifier naming a twin: m2v's, which the cut deletes, or raw's own barrier, stride, split,
#   reach and turned forms, which S4 renames), nvk (an NVK or NAK export or image name), dlsym (a name looked up at run
#   time), kernel (a kernel submission entry only NVK calls).
# raised_in: the files that raise it. gone: what it becomes once m2v is deleted: native (raw's own form exists, the route
#   is plumbing), form (Metal allows it and raw has no form yet: build one), error (Metal's failure, logged by the line
#   `logs` names: an error line kept in release), dead (unreachable without m2v: delete it), none (not an m2v route).
# owner: the studio branch or queued builder, cut (the builder that deletes m2v), - (none yet). status: open (work left
#   before the cut), cut (the cut deletes it, nothing to build), main (main already does what gone says),
#   <branch>@<hash> (built on that studio branch, not merged).
# boot21 (T-v5b's log): cbs= m2v command buffers (predicates), procs= processes that logged the line (once per process
#   and key), asked=/opened= processes whose site asked m2v for the need and that opened m2v for it (once per process

column10: note

a buffer of another device or a nil one bound, drawn with, blitted, filled, copied, resolved into, read as indirect arguments or an execute's range, or encoded into an indirect command (Metal's validation error; an M4 Max with validation off dereferences a nil one, c38-audit/m2v-cut2/probe, c38-audit/failed-counts/probe): the command buffer fails InvalidResource as it is recorded and the call records nothing (rmCallInvalid; an indirect command's at the execute that reaches it; raw_facade_foreign_test)
a copy or fill past its buffer: clamped to the bytes inside both, as Apple's driver (raw_client_errors.h), the command buffer completed, one line

every sampler the device makes is raw's (opaque borders eaab3c64f, pixel mirror-once 9c1f3abd3), one it has no form of is nil (raw:sampler.unsupported); a sampler of another device bound fails the command buffer at its recording (Metal's validation error, MTLCommandBufferErrorInternal), an opaque border header the table has no entry for fails it MTLCommandBufferErrorOutOfMemory at the encode (m2v-draws; raw_facade_open_test ASamplerOfAnotherDeviceFailsItsCommandBuffer, AnOpaqueBorderDrawWithTheHeaderTableFullFailsItsCommandBuffer)

a sampler descriptor the device has no form of (an enum out of range, a NaN lod clamp, a cubic filter with a mip filter, anisotropy, a border of 3 or a mirror-clamp axis) or no header slot: nil, as Metal answers a sampler it cannot make

accumulated results are raw's (the counter's ADD-reducing report, a copy-engine OR gated on the count); what still reaches it Metal's validation stops (MTLRenderCommandEncoder.h setVisibilityResultMode:offset:): no buffer, past it, a mode Metal lacks, an offset twice, a result buffer of another device (m2v-draws; raw_facade_errors_test AVisibilityBufferOfAnotherDeviceFails): the command buffer fails

a call Metal's validation stops fails its command buffer InvalidResource as it is recorded and records nothing: a pipeline state, buffer, texture, sampler, used resource or heap of another device (an indirect dispatch command's at the execute that reaches it), a stage-in region buffer of another device, off 4 bytes or past it, a dispatch with no state set, indirect dispatch arguments of another device; indirect dispatch arguments are read as an M4 Max's GPU reads them (c38-audit/m2v-compute/probe): at their offset rounded down to 4 bytes, a grid whose last word lies past the buffer reading it zero and launching nothing (skipped.compute, this line; the command buffer completes); a dispatch or kernel command the encode refuses fails it as raw::ComputeFailure names it: OutOfMemory (no memory for a kernel's argument tables, no header for a kernel's view of another format), else Internal (a record or plan breaking what its making guarantees)

rows or a start 16 off 32 and cropped surface views run raw through their own images (copy engine, raw_kernel_shadow.h: TIC ADDRESS_BITS31TO5 and PITCH_BITS20TO5 address neither); a converted texture's address map (Texture::addressMap: a P3-matrix texture's is the codes map, a planar one's 2) is in its kernel's key (raw_compute_key.h ":am<map>"), so the compile makes the kernel's sampler headers under the map the dispatch binds and a record that says so (PackKernel::mapsStated) binds them as made (compile side: compile-gaps, c38-audit/m2v-compute/term3-contract.txt); what admission still refuses fails the command buffer Internal at the recording and at readiness: an RGB10A8_2P_XR10 record reading neither its planes nor its stand-in (its key names which: a guard), and in a record of no stated maps (a pack made before mapsStated) a converted texture beside a sampler its map changes

a kernel the shader compiler refused or could not make fails its command buffer Internal as it is recorded, at readiness, or at an indirect command buffer's execute (compile-path gaps, with compile-gaps); every compute state is keyed (one no compile can name is not made); an extended-range texture at a slot its kernel does not store (made without ShaderWrite, or a slot the state's reflection gives no write access) is keyed at its RGBA16Float stand-in, so a mip-filtered, anisotropic or mixed sampler over it compiles and binds the stand-in; indirect dispatch commands carry what dispatches do: argument tables, heap sets, a root slot table and an argument table of bind offsets of their own or inherited buffers (the bind macro writes inherited entries and residuals, a residual word the record fills taken back), any count of binds and launches (each buffer's slots grow to its largest command's); one with no state or Metal-invalid threads fails InvalidResource; a bind stride past 2^24 over an inherited buffer longer than 2^24 fails Internal (BLOCKED: 128 MME scratch words, 3 a slot, 24 free bits above X1's 40-bit address; a shorter buffer takes the largest held stride, which reads alike); no memory for its regions (or regions past 4 GB) OutOfMemory, written again at the next execute that reaches it; a buffer entry with no residual word (a slot the program never addresses, while compile refuses a plan that changes under a bind offset) binds at its base rounded down to 16 bytes, nothing copied; an empty grid launches nothing

a predication Start or an EndDoWhile naming no buffer runs as an M4 Max's GPU runs it (c38-audit/m2v-compute/probe): no failure, every End of its encoder answers NO, and no dispatch or indirect execute of its compute unit launches (the run of compute encoders of one dispatch type holding it, those before it too, up to a blit, a render pass, an event signal or wait, or a change of dispatch type, each measured); predication raw cannot run fails the command buffer: a misused record, a word outside its buffer or a buffer of another device InvalidResource; a loop raw cannot lay down Internal
a state of the other 8-bit channel order drawn into the pass's format, another format skipped, as Apple's driver, completed, one line

a state of another depth/stencil format than its pass's is drawn against the pass's attachment, as Apple's GPU draws it (an M4 Max, validation off: states of no depth, Depth16Unorm, Depth32Float, Depth32Float_Stencil8 and Stencil8 under passes of none, Depth32Float and Depth32Float_Stencil8 all depth tested and written at the pass's format; raw_facade_errors_test AStateOfAnotherDepthFormatDrawsAgainstThePasssAttachment); encode-time ends: no memory or header for shader-test stand-ins fails OutOfMemory (raw:draw.tests_memory), a shadow stencil without its StencilWrite variant or a hidden attachment the pass was not given fails Internal (raw:draw.tests_variant); a shader test of an aspect or sample count the pass's attachment lacks is Metal's validation error (raw:draw.depth_stencil) and one of an attachment the copy takes no form of (a Depth16Unorm its pass did not convert) the driver's (raw:draw.tests_variant), both RefDepthStencil onto m2v before (m2v-draw-ends). Left: an ordered storage variant made for another test class than the draw's (reachable now that a state of another depth format draws; its form is the class keyed on the pass's attachment format, RawMetalCubic.mm drawnTests). A shader depth test over a Depth16Unorm attachment renders the pass through the converted Depth32Float_Stencil8 a Depth16Unorm + Stencil8 pair takes (RMPass::shaderTestsDepth, RawMetalRangeForms.mm depth16Tested; m2v-passes); the RangeSeal resolve sites are pass.ds's

every draw of a state that fetches a colour it writes through the texture unit is the raw path's: one fetch macro call (SWITCH_GM20B_MACRO_FETCH_DRAW, kits/SwitchGM20BEmit) draws each instance as one split draw, a BEGIN a primitive behind the fetch barrier, of any count, topology, restart, primitive ID and instance count, indirect draws through the GPFIFO continuation, and an indirect command buffer's commands through the same body in its draw macros (FETCH_ICB). A tessellated draw of such a state with no storage form for its pass ends on raw (raw:draw.fetch_patches, MTLCommandBufferErrorInternal; PredEncGeometry is only refusalPred's name for RefGeometry now): BLOCKED by the hardware, the fetch barrier sits between BEGINs (clb197.h:1079) and the tessellator makes a patch's triangles inside one, the pixel interlock (clb197.h:2030-2040) orders only inside a program's own ticket section, which only the storage form has; the native rung is a storage form for those states (raw/plan/fetch_no_storage.tsv), the compile side's (raw_device_fetch_patches_test, raw_facade_draw_ends_test)
indirect arguments past their buffer read as zeros, an index type or index range Metal reads nothing of skips the draw, as Apple's driver, completed, one line
the kernel refused the submission: the command buffer fails Internal, its line naming the kernel's answer (kernelResult) or why nothing was submitted
the kernel refused the channel or its context: the command buffer fails Internal, its line naming the channel error

every texture made for sampling has its header from its making (m2v-textures2: createLaidOut, the zetas; a stand-in where the texture has MTLTextureUsageShaderRead), so one a draw samples with none is memoryless or not made for reading: Metal's validation error at the draw that samples it (the bind is recorded, as Metal takes one at a slot no function reads), its command buffer failed with raw:draw.no_header, as is a variant without a two-plane texture's header pair; a fetch view's header the table has no entry for fails OutOfMemory (raw:draw.view_header)

The raw path's own passes around a pass (resolve, conversion, XR plane and shadow passes) and a pass render() refuses once the recording failed Metal's errors fail the command buffer OutOfMemory or Internal (RawMetalPassErrors.h rmPassWorkFails); a YCbCr texture's image render() refuses fails OutOfMemory (RawMetalRangeConversions.mm makeImages); an extended-range or RG8Unorm_sRGB stand-in's conversion that fails ends on raw (raw:standin.conversion); every draw refusal ends in RawMetalDrawErrors.mm, one of no id as raw:draw.unnamed: a planar texture sampled by comparison draws through its sampler's compare header under the map (Sampler::compareMapped; raw_device_draw_ends_test), a sampler header the range did not make is raw:draw.sampler_header, a colour matrix form's draw with no uniform holding the matrix raw:draw.matrix_uniform (m2v-draw-ends). No site sends work to m2v. Every two-plane RGB10A8_2P_XR10 texture a pass's draws write takes an image, as many as the draws name: past raw::PassDesc's 24 inline ones in the range encode's list (PassDesc::morePlanes), each on its own backing tag (RawMetalXrPlanes.h xrPlanesImageTag: from 128 on past the 24th), so valid work no longer fails (raw_facade_xr_images_test: 25 and 40 render). Ends as an error only for want of memory or a refused draw of the raw path's own; a draw on a parallel sub-encoder after its parent ended is skipped and counted under it (raw:parallel.ended_sub)

a sampler header under a planar texture's address map: constexpr samplers over planar textures (x1-m2v-forms@c5ca1af3a, HW Test gpu.raw.planar_constexpr); a sampler state's or a constexpr sampler's header the table has no entry left for fails the command buffer MTLCommandBufferErrorOutOfMemory with this line (raw_facade_open_test APlanarDrawWithTheHeaderTableFullFailsItsCommandBuffer; the constexpr half m2v-draws); compare forms and map variants share header slots (42ab8c1fa)

Planar and YCbCr targets of every usage render, as an M4 Max renders a texture of any usage (raw/test/ycbcrnorenderoracle.mm, m2v-passes2 probe/nort.mm). YCbCr ones through their memoryless stand-in; an RGB8_444_2P one made without render-target usage through an RGBA16Float stand-in of its command buffer's (raw_planar_target.h, backing tag kPlanarScratchTag + slot) and its planes as targets of no header (m2v-textures5; raw_facade_planar_targets_test). Stored as an M4 Max stores them (m2v-textures5 probes/targets.mm, edges.mm): over plane 1 its luma codes alone into that plane; taller than its surface or of chroma unlike the surface's, each plane's rows at its pitch on past the plane's end, chroma over luma where they meet; of an odd size, each edge chroma block the mean of the texels inside it (pack/ycbcr_store.metal chromaCodes; raw_ycbcr_test TargetsStoreAsTheyRead). One-plane targets (m2v-textures6): 501, 521 and 562 store their two-plane 4:2:2 twin's codes into their luma and chroma images, merged into the pairs by the copy engine (BlitEncoder::mergePlane; an odd width's last pair keeps its second luma byte: m2v-textures6 probes/onep.mm); 504 and 524 store a word a texel through their plane's RGB10A2Unorm header (ycbcr_store_words*_frag). An RGB8_444_2P one the planar path leaves (rows that overlap, taller than its planes, planes of other elements) renders as a YCbCr codes target through an RGBA16Float stand-in, the format its pipelines render (raw_ycbcr.cpp, RawMetalYcbcrTargets.mm makeYcbcrTarget; raw_ycbcr_test). Rows that overlap (a plane's pitch below its row; Metal takes them, and asserts a one-plane pitch under half its row) (m2v-textures7): the store states draw the rows into the plane's pool image (Texture::sampled, or a one-plane target's luma and chroma images), then one pass of the pack's overlap state a plane draws each plane byte from the row whose store lands last (raw_overlap_order.h, raw_overlap_rows.h; states ycbcr_overlap_{r8,r16,rg8,rg16,rgb10a2,r32ui}_frag): an M4 Max stores 64x32-texel tiles, each by 32-texel column, then row pair, the even row after the odd, the tiles concurrently in no fixed order (m2v-textures7 probes/overlap.mm, onepover.mm: 53 shapes and 10 one-plane ones, 8 runs each, no byte against the rule within a tile); the order taken, tiles from the last tile row up and each row's last tile back, is every run of each shape whose runs agree and the likeliest of the rest (probes/fit4.py), and the states run on the M4 Max give Apple's bytes on those shapes (probes/shaderprobe.mm) (raw_ycbcr_store_test RowsThatOverlapKeepTheRowAppleStoresLast, RowsThatOverlapStoreOnlyFromReachedTiles; raw_facade_planar_targets_test AYcbcrTargetWhoseRowsOverlapRendersIntoItsPlanesBytes). What still fails a pass into one, Internal at record (RawMetalYcbcrTargets.mm ycbcrTargetPassRefusal, raw:pass.ycbcr, after raw:ycbcr.target at creation): no memory for its stand-in, a pack without its store or overlap state, or a packed target smaller than its surface (an M4 Max faults on one: raw_ycbcr.cpp). Encode: the stand-in, plane-load, store and overlap passes and the reach fail OutOfMemory on want of memory, Internal on a refused draw (RawMetalPassErrors.h rmPassWorkFails, rmOwnDrawFails; RawMetalReach.h rmReachFails); an RGB8_444_2P pass with no scratch for its stand-in fails OutOfMemory (RawMetalRangePass.mm); RawMetalRangeSeal.mm's no-backing check is behind the record's and cannot fire. Written and sampled in one command buffer (m2v-planar-plan): after an encoder writes a converted texture's surface its image is drawn again from the planes ahead of the next work that samples it (RawMetalRangeConversions.mm remakeImages; raw_facade_planar_sample_test, HW Test gpu.raw.planar_render_then_sample)
one-sample state in a pass of more writes sample 0, many in one draws whole, as Apple's driver; others skipped; completed, one line

every refusal of a draw's storage form ends on raw (RawMetalDrawErrors.mm; PredEncStorageView is only refusalPred's name for RefStorageView now): a pass of another sample count than the state's is Metal's validation error (raw:draw.storage_samples), a view of another texel size the driver's (raw:draw.storage_view), a fetch's storage view with no header OutOfMemory (raw:draw.view_header, also where the header has no form), a shadow variant with no shadow the driver's (raw:draw.xr_shadow). Inferred: no valid state reaches them, a non-blend form taking its barrier twin where its attachment does not fit (RenderEncoder::formFor) and a blended one (a blendTwin alone) meeting only attachments of its state's colour format and samples. The device cases: HW Test 12 Nov linear_depth_adjacent ran raw at C32 (m2v_cbs=0); C32's layered_fetch one_layer_linear renders through a block-linear backing (raw_facade_fused_storage_test) (raw_device_draw_ends_test, raw_facade_draw_ends_test)
a plain event or a fence this device did not make fails at recording; an inlined signal with no lease (a guard) fails Internal

No depth/stencil attachment leaves raw (m2v-passes3, RawMetalPassAttachments.h rmRawDepthStencil): Metal's validation errors at record (raw:pass.invalid), resolves into another device's texture, one without the aspect, or past its texture too; the aspects apart (two textures, or one at two levels or slices, Depth32Float_Stencil8 beside a Stencil8, a Depth32Float beside a Depth32Float_Stencil8's stencil, of two extents: an M4 Max keeps each aspect in its own texture and part and renders their smallest extent: raw/test/passformsoracle.mm zeta_two_*, mixed_pairs, pair_sizes) through the pair's Depth32Float_Stencil8 (raw::PassDesc::separate; the copies and render area m2v-pass-forms' raw_zeta.cpp, raw_pass_begin.cpp); an X32_Stencil8 view is the stencil of the texture it views (stencil_view); levels of views through their texture's chain (rmZetaPart); depth and stencil resolves into a level, a slice and another zeta format (zeta_resolves), one into a memoryless texture fails MTLCommandBufferErrorInvalidResource as an M4 Max fails it. Fails Internal at record, named: a layered Depth16Unorm beside a stencil (m2v-pass-forms builds it), a multisampled Depth16Unorm kept with no conversion states, a resolve into a multisampled texture; encode-time ends of zeta resolves fail OutOfMemory or Internal

No colour attachment leaves raw (RawMetalPassAttachments.h rmColorTargetMissing, m2v-passes3): Metal's validation errors at record (raw:pass.invalid), MTLPixelFormatUnspecialized (263) too (an M4 Max makes no texture of it by descriptor, view or buffer: raw/test/passformsoracle.mm unspecialized); RG8Unorm_sRGB through an RGBA8Unorm_sRGB stand-in and its first two bytes (exact to an M4 Max in draws, clears and blends over loaded bytes: rg8_srgb); a texture buffer as its row, a pitch target (one past 16384 texels fails Internal, as an M4 Max fails it: texture_buffer, unspecialized_views); a view's whole first level of several levels or a 1D view bound as it is (rmWholeViewTarget); a turned texture of a stand-in format through a stand-in laid out as its plane and marked turned (TurnedPass draws it); stand-in formats layered and multisampled (m2v-passes2); a whole one-sample Depth32Float or Depth16Unorm as its colour twin (m2v-pass-forms). Fails Internal at record, named: a multisampled stand-in of a sample count the pack has no per-sample states of, a level or slice of a depth texture as colour, a texture the raw path holds no texels of (no creator hands one out: each answers nil)

No colour part leaves raw (m2v-passes3): levels, slices and planes of block-linear images (raw_attachment_target.h); a plane of a 3D texture laid out several planes a block (made without render-target usage, which an M4 Max renders: raw/test/norenderoracle.mm) through a one-plane-a-block image the copy engine fills and drains (raw::planeInBlocks, RawMetalRangeForms.mm planeImage); a slice of a linear array as one pitch layer (raw::pitchSliceTarget); a level past the first of a view of several levels through the chain of the texture it views (RawMetalTargetViews.h rawPartOwner). Resolves: as m2v-passes and m2v-passes2 built them, as far as Metal's Clear reaches (the render area in whole 32-pixel tiles in a pass that drew, the whole attachment in one that did not: HW Test gpu.raw.resolve_codes_parts area case, passformsoracle.mm area_store), and into another sample count's texture for a pass that records no draw alone (an M4 Max leaves it as it was after a drawn pass: HW Test gpu.raw.resolve_other_count). Fails at record, named: Metal's validation errors (raw:pass.invalid), a resolve with no form, a slice of a linear array of a stand-in format, a resolved part of a multisampled texture (none: no multisampled arrays are made)

At record every attachment Metal takes moves through a turn copy state, so a refusal there fails the command buffer as the driver's (Internal); at encode a turn copy back that fails fails it too; the begin's reach draws every draw kind again, and its failure, or the begin's for want of memory, fails the command buffer OutOfMemory or Internal (RawMetalReach.h rmReachFails, TurnedPass::failedForMemory; raw_facade_reach_test). A turned variant is placed at its first turned draw (raw_device_room_test, HW Test gpu.x1.rotated_target), a turned draw finding no room for it fails OutOfMemory (raw:draw.turned_memory; raw_facade_draw_ends_test), and a state whose record holds no turned fragment program is raw:pass.turn_refused

a render or depth/stencil state of another device, or a nil render state (an M4 Max with validation off dereferences it): the command buffer fails InvalidResource as it is recorded (rmCallInvalid; raw_facade_foreign_test)

a texture of another device or a nil one: blitted, copied, filled or used (useResource:), the command buffer fails InvalidResource as it is recorded and the call records nothing (rmCallInvalid; an M4 Max dereferences a nil one, c38-audit/failed-counts/probe; raw_facade_foreign_test); bound, it fails Internal (rmBindTexture). Every texture the device hands out is the raw path's (_rawOk)
a command buffer selector no method of raw answers: every MTLCommandBuffer selector is raw's, so it is no Metal selector: answered zero with this error line

an encoder selector no method of raw answers: indirect dispatch and its stage-in region are raw (x1-m2v-forms); what is left is answered zero with this error line: no Metal selector of the claimed families, and setPrimitiveRestartEnabled:NO, setViewportTransformEnabled:NO, setProvokingVertexMode: other than 0 and setLineWidth: other than 1 (RawMetalRenderEncoder.mm forwardCall), each of which needs raw's form
a compressed texture's pages asked inside a raw encode: refused, raw's own
raw's counters: no clock anchors from the kernel
raw's counters: Metal's invalid sample index
raw's counters: Metal's out-of-bounds resolve
raw's counters: a resolve into a destination off 4 bytes (skipped.call.counter; an M4 Max resolves it there), or past its end (the samples it holds resolved, as an M4 Max)
raw's counters: the resolve kernel was not made
raw's counters: Metal lacks its counter set classes

a draw at a vertex amplification count above its state's maxVertexAmplificationCount: Metal's validation error (an M4 Max's validation layer: "Vertex Amplification Count (3) must be between (inclusive) 1 and the maximum vertex amplification count specified in the pipeline state (2)"; MTLRenderCommandEncoder.h setVertexAmplificationCount:viewMappings:), the command buffer fails with its line; was enc.pass with no predicate (RenderEncoder::drawnWordsRefusal)

a depth clamp (MTLDepthClipModeClamp) on a state whose registers set no clip control: every state the stack records sets it (raw_emit.cpp kViewportClip), so the draw is the driver's error: MTLCommandBufferErrorInternal (MTLCommandBuffer.h) with this line; was enc.pass with no predicate

an execute of indirect commands past the buffer's commands: Metal's validation error (an M4 Max's validation layer: "Specified range (loc=2, len=6) is not inside the command buffer with size 4"; MTLRenderCommandEncoder.h executeCommandsInBuffer:withRange:), the command buffer fails with its line; was enc.pass with no predicate. Through the facade the recording runs no such execute first (RawMetalIndirect.mm, raw:icb.range: none run), so the draw's check is a guard

an execute whose range it reads from a buffer at an offset off 4 bytes or past the buffer, which Metal's validation takes (an M4 Max completes offsets 2 and 4092 of 4096 bytes): the recording runs no such execute (RawMetalIndirect.mm executeCommandsInBuffer:indirectBuffer:, raw:icb.range), so the draw's check is a guard: the driver's error, MTLCommandBufferErrorInternal (MTLCommandBuffer.h) with this line; was enc.pass with no predicate

control-point indices at an offset off their index size: Metal's validation error (an M4 Max's validation layer: "controlPointIndexBufferOffset(2) must be a multiple of 4 bytes"; MTLRenderCommandEncoder.h drawIndexedPatches:), the command buffer fails with its line; was enc.pass with no predicate

no memory for the handle tables and roots a state reads argument buffers through (Device::bindArguments): the command buffer fails MTLCommandBufferErrorOutOfMemory (MTLCommandBuffer.h) with its line; was enc.pass with no predicate

an indirect draw's arguments off 4 bytes or past their buffer, or an indirect patch draw of none: Metal's validation error (an M4 Max's validation layer: "indirectBufferOffset(2) must be a multiple of 4 bytes", "(indirectBufferOffset + sizeof(MTLDrawPrimitivesIndirectArguments))(4108) must be <= [indirectBuffer length](4096)"), the command buffer fails with its line; was enc.pass with no predicate. Through the facade the recording refuses such arguments first (RawMetalRenderEncoder.mm drawIndirect: enc.idxrange), so the draw's check is reached by an indirect patch draw of nil arguments alone

an indexed indirect draw's index buffer offset off its index size: Metal's validation error (an M4 Max's validation layer: "indexBufferOffset(2) must be a multiple of 4 bytes"; MTLRenderCommandEncoder.h drawIndexedPrimitives:...indirectBuffer:), the command buffer fails with its line; was enc.pass with no predicate. Through the facade the recording refuses such an offset first (drawIndirect: enc.idxrange); an offset at or past the buffer's end, which Metal's validation takes, the recording passes and the draw reads index 0 from the zero page (x1-m2v-forms-refusals2)

a one-layer record of a slice-choosing state (the bridge's LAYER_DROPPED) drawn in a layered pass: the layered forms of the four kinds are built or unreachable: the in-shader depth and stencil tests' stand-ins and the shader-side stencil's shadow are 2D arrays of the pass's layers (x1-m2v-forms-refusals2 71b38f3fc, key x1-m2v-forms-key-refusals2 223ffd21a; HW Tests gpu.raw.layered_shader_tests, gpu.raw.layered_shader_stencil), an imageblock or tile memory has no raw record at one layer, the raw path holds no extended-range shadow in a layered pass (rmXrShadowBegin); LAYER_DROPPED remains only for a multisampled storage form and no layered pass is multisampled (raw_layers.h), so a record that meets one is the driver's error: MTLCommandBufferErrorInternal (MTLCommandBuffer.h) with this line; was a form row. Reopens if a layered multisampled pass or an imageblock or tile-memory record ever becomes raw's

an indirect command buffer's patch commands of a state whose control stage reads set 0 by its address (RenderEncoder::icbPatchLayout): unreachable from the stack (the control stage is m2v's synthesized module, control.rs, reading set 0 through three non-indexed storage buffers; NVK's build_cbuf_map maps that set to a constant buffer under 16 bindings unless the shader is indirect-bindable, which only m2v-runtime asks; nvk_switch_capture names it CbufSet, so Pipeline::setSlot[2] is set), so a record that is one anyway is the driver's error: MTLCommandBufferErrorInternal (MTLCommandBuffer.h) with this line (DeviceIcb.AControlStageReadingSetZeroByItsAddressIsTheDriversError); was a form row. Reopens if a control stage is ever made other than by the synthesized module, or the bridge ever sets the indirect-bindable bit (VK_SHADER_CREATE_INDIRECT_BINDABLE_BIT_EXT)

a draw of a state whose argument table words its pipeline does not hold: a pack split twin of a state with argument tables was built without their words (Device::makeSplit) and refused its draws; such a state is now offered no split (raw_split.cpp offerSplit), so the site is the driver's error for a record that breaks it: MTLCommandBufferErrorInternal (MTLCommandBuffer.h) with this line; was enc.pass with no predicate

a record's vertex stream of a Metal buffer index past 30: a vertex descriptor's buffers are 0 to 30 (MTLVertexDescriptor.h), so no current record has one; a record that is one anyway is the driver's error: MTLCommandBufferErrorInternal (MTLCommandBuffer.h) with this line; was enc.pass with no predicate
